retail.tools: Capstone and pefile (.tmp/jk2-mp3-sounds/pe_tool.py, not committed); zipfile for the paks; the committed tests/fixtures/stvef_mp3_probe.cpp for decoding
retail.names: functions carry the names the engines' own strings give them (S_FindName, S_RegisterSound, LoopSound_ChannelInit, S_AddLoopSounds, S_StartBackgroundTrack, MP3Stream_InitPlayingTimeFields) or the usual id Tech/Raven names where they give none (COM_StripExtension, MP3_IsValid, MP3_GetUnpackedSize, MP3_ReadSpecialTagInfo, MP3Stream_InitFromFile); the behaviour is read from the code, not from the names

S_RegisterSound.note: returns 0 before the sound system starts; NULL, empty or >= 64-character names are fatal errors (0x427ed0, code 0)

S_FindName.rule: COM_StripExtension (mp 0x434220, sp 0x41f1d0) copies up to the first "." anywhere in the name; that stem is hashed (mp 0x45cd20, sp 0x423a60), compared and stored at sfx+0x18, so x.wav, x.mp3 and x are one sound with one handle

register.defaultSound: mp S_BeginRegistration registers "*defaultsound" (0x45ce04) and fills it with a generated sound (0x45cd70); a sound that fails to load is marked default and S_RegisterSound prints "^3WARNING: could not find %s - using default" (0x45cee6)

S_LoadSound.sp rule: a stored name shorter than five characters fails; Q_strncpyz + strlwr; a name whose fourth-last character is not "." gets COM_DefaultExtension(".wav") (0x42a992); the stored stem has no "." so this is always ".wav"

fileLoadAndNameAdjuster.rule: FS_ReadFile (mp 0x42ccf0, sp 0x417f10) of the .wav; only if it is absent, the last three characters become "mp3" (mp 0x45f6dd, sp 0x42af7c) and the file is read again

foreignVoices.rule: a name containing "chars" (strstr, case-sensitive) is tried with "chr_d" when s_language is DEUTSCH or "chr_f" when FRANCAIS, .wav then .mp3; if neither exists the English .wav then .mp3
foreignVoices.buildScript: with com_buildScript set, both foreign .wav and .mp3 are opened and closed so they are packed (mp 0x45f545..0x45f640)

load.decoderChoice: the loaded name's own extension: ".mp3" (Q_stricmpn, mp 0x45f104, sp 0x42aa08) -> MP3_IsValid (mp 0x45fe00, sp 0x409cf0) and MP3_GetUnpackedSize (mp 0x45fe40, sp 0x409d30), which takes Raven's #UNCOMP tag when present (MP3_ReadSpecialTagInfo mp 0x45ff90) and otherwise measures; anything else -> GetWavinfo (mp 0x45f2f0), and a stereo WAV is refused ("%s is a stereo wav file": mp 0x4fe250 pushed at 0x45f25f, sp 0x4dc970 at 0x42ac70)

MP3Stream_InitFromFile.rule: keep the MP3 compressed and decode it while playing when (float)compressed + s_mp3overhead < (float)(unpacked + 2304); otherwise unpack at load ("S_LoadSound: Unpacking MP3 file \"%s\" to wav.", mp 0x45f16c)

streamedMp3.perChannelState: S_StartSound copies 0x1a03 words of the sound's MP3 stream header (sfx+0x10) into the channel at +0x3c, or zeroes them for an unpacked sound (mp 0x45d336..0x45d35a)

loopsRefuse.mp: LoopSound_ChannelInit 0x45d750: ERR_DROP "LoopSound_ChannelInit(): Cannot use streamed MP3 files here for random access (%s)" (0x4fdce0, pushed at 0x45d7ba)
loopsRefuse.sp: S_AddLoopSounds: ERR_DROP "S_AddLoopSounds(): Cannot use streamed MP3 files here for random access (%s)" (0x4dbd20, pushed at 0x424bcb)

streamedMp3.mixerRate: s_khz "22" (mp 0x45c9a8, sp 0x423256); MP3Stream_InitFromFile starts a compressed sound's decoder at dma.speed ([0xb7f220]) and 16 bits (mp 0x4601b5..0x4601c5)

installationAtDefaults.unpackedSizeUsed: Raven's #UNCOMP where present (all but 16 sound MP3s), else Fn's decoded mono byte count

S_StartBackgroundTrack.rule: COM_DefaultExtension(".mp3") on the intro (0x45e313) and S_FileExists (0x45e200, FS_FOpenFileRead with no fallback); a missing file prints "^1ERROR: Unable to find music file:\n( %s )" and stops the music
S_StartBackgroundTrack.sp: COM_DefaultExtension(".mp3") at 0x4273b5; dynamic music sets ("music/%s/%s.mp3") beside it

S_StartBackgroundTrack_Actual.rule: a ".mp3" name (0x45e414 / 0x42765e) opens an MP3 stream; any other opens a WAV stream; mp defaults a bare name to ".wav" (0x45e3a9), sp to ".mp3" (0x4275ed)

music.mpLoopRestart: when the intro ends, mp tries "<loop>.wav" (0x45eac1..0x45eae4) and opens it if it exists; otherwise it restarts the loop through S_StartBackgroundTrack, i.e. ".mp3"

requestedNames.how: every sound/ or music/ name in the multiplayer QVMs' data, map entity lumps, text data files, jk2mp.exe, jk2sp.exe and jk2gamex86.dll (.tmp/jk2-mp3-sounds/requested_names.py); names include prefixes the modules complete at run time, which show as missing

loops.note: target_speaker entities with spawnflags 1 or 2 in every map, plus loop-like names in vm/cgame.qvm; every multiplayer loop found is a WAV (missileloop ships in neither format); single player's MP3 loops all lie outside sound/chars/, which it never keeps streamed

decode.how: tests/fixtures/stvef_mp3_probe.cpp (Fn's frame walker + minimp3 configuration) over every .mp3 in both paks, extracted under .tmp and deleted (.tmp/jk2-mp3-sounds/decode_sweep.py)
decode.ravenUncompReproduced: 7,970 of 7,971 equal Fn's decoded mono byte count at 44.1 kHz

exception.cause: one stray byte sits between the last frame (19,435..19,643) and the ID3v1 tag at 19,645; minimp3 then returns no samples for that final frame, so Fn plays 92 frames (26 ms short)

fnTech3.before: S_CodecInit registered mp3_codec only for Elite Force, the Ritual titles, Medal of Honor and both Academy profiles. In jk2-sp/jk2-mp a .wav name failed after .wav and .ogg; an .mp3 name matched no codec, was not cut, and was tried as "x.mp3.wav" and "x.mp3.ogg", so even its .wav failed; a bare music name tried .wav and .ogg only
change: code/client/audio/codecs/snd_codec.cpp S_CodecInit: Com_GameIsJK2() joins the MP3 condition; the list is WAV, MP3, Ogg Vorbis as for the other MP3 titles

code/client/audio/codecs/snd_codec.cpp S_JK2SoundFile + S_CodecLoad: an Outcast sound loads as "<name>.wav", the name cut at the first "." of its file name, so the codec list reads .wav, then .mp3, then Fn's Ogg Vorbis; a stem too long for MAX_QPATH with ".wav" loads as given; Elite Force's German voices and every other profile are unchanged
music keeps Fn's stream lookup (S_CodecOpenStream): the name as given, or WAV, MP3, Ogg Vorbis for a bare name; every one of the 27 music names the installation uses resolves to its .mp3
differencesRecorded: one handle per stem in retail; Fn registers each name (x.wav and x.mp3 are two handles for one file)

retail keeps large MP3s compressed and decodes per channel at its 22 kHz mixer rate; Fn decodes every effect whole at the file's 44.1 kHz and its mixers resample, so no sound is ever "streamed" and any MP3 can loop where retail drops the game; no retail multiplayer loop is an MP3, and single player never streams the MP3 loops its maps use
retail cuts at the first "." anywhere in the path; Fn at the first "." of the file name (a dotted folder breaks the name in retail)

music: retail looks for "<bare name>.mp3" only, and multiplayer's loop restart for "<loop>.wav" first; Fn tries .wav, .mp3, .ogg for a bare name and falls back for a missing one; the same file for every music name the installation uses
foreign voices (chr_d/chr_f by s_language) are not implemented; s_language is registered only for Elite Force
Fn's jk2 profiles register Quake III's sound/feedback/hit.wav as handle 0, which Outcast ships in neither format, so handle 0 stays Fn's generated fallback tone (retail: a generated *defaultsound)

diagnostics retail never prints: "Sound fallback: x.wav -> x.mp3" (developer) for every MP3 load, the legacy mixer's "is not a 22kHz audio file" (developer) for every 44.1 kHz sound and its "music file %s is not 22k stereo" for every track
